title: Book Two · Chapter 76: A Pair That Fits
story:
One summer morning, Mum takes Ronan to buy shoes. His old pair lies in the bag beside her. The front of one shoe has a thin pale mark from his big toe.

“Stand up in these,” Mum says.

Ronan has a new pair on his feet. They look smart, with dark sides and bright laces. He stands and walks three steps. His toes touch the ends.

“They are good,” he says.

Mum looks at his face. “Walk back.”

He walks back slowly. The left shoe presses his little toe. He stops beside the stool.

“Do they hurt?”

“A little. They will get bigger.”

“Your feet will get bigger too.”

The seller brings another size. These have room at the front. But the backs slip as he walks. He looks at the first pair again.

“I like those.”

“We can try another shape,” Mum says.

The next pair is plain brown. Ronan does not like it as much. He puts it on and stands. His heel stays in place. He bends his toes. There is room.

Mum asks him to walk farther along the clear part of the stall. He does. The soles make almost no sound.

He comes back and looks down.

“These do not hurt.”

“Try the other shoe properly.”

He ties both laces. Then he walks again. The brown shoes still fit. Mum checks the price. Then she agrees to buy them.

They carry the old shoes home in the bag. Ronan wants to throw them away at once. Mum asks him to clean them first. One shoe is still strong enough for yard work. But both are too small for Ronan now.

Dad checks them that evening. They will ask the neighbour about a smaller child. Ronan washes the dirt from the soles and leaves them to dry.

The next day, the neighbour tries them for a young relative. One shoe presses the child's foot too. The pair comes back. Ronan puts it beside the door for Dad to sort with the worn things. Ronan wanted to give the pair away. But these shoes hurt that child too.

In his new shoes, Ronan goes to meet Leo. Leo notices the quiet soles.

“You can walk behind Jun.”

Ronan tries. Jun turns before he reaches him.

“I can see your shadow,” Jun says.

Ronan looks down at the long dark shape beside his feet. He steps sideways. The shadow moves with him. Leo starts laughing. Ronan has no time to try again.

## 词句提示

fit＝合脚；toe＝脚趾；sole＝鞋底。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan试鞋时怎样改变选择？
2. 旧鞋得到怎样的处理？

## 读句子

**He / bends / his toes.** 他／弯动／脚趾。
